name: awc-ui-monorepo
description: Accessible Material Design 3 Web Components for React, Angular, Vue, and Svelte, with Next.js, Nuxt, SvelteKit, and Angular SSR

scripts.lint: pnpm lint:eslint && pnpm lint:stylelint && turbo run lint
scripts.ci:wrappers: pnpm --filter @awc-ui/react --filter @awc-ui/vue --filter @awc-ui/angular --filter @awc-ui/svelte --filter @awc-ui/theme build && node scripts/fix-declarations.mjs react vue angular svelte theme
scripts.ci:publint: publint packages/core && publint packages/react && publint packages/vue && publint packages/svelte && publint packages/theme && publint packages/angular && publint packages/tokens && publint packages/mcp
scripts.ci:attw: attw --pack packages/core --profile node16 --ignore-rules no-resolution cjs-resolves-to-esm && attw --pack packages/react --ignore-rules false-cjs cjs-resolves-to-esm no-resolution && attw --pack packages/vue --ignore-rules cjs-resolves-to-esm internal-resolution-error && attw --pack packages/svelte --profile esm-only --ignore-rules internal-resolution-error && attw --pack packages/theme --profile esm-only --ignore-rules internal-resolution-error
scripts.test:adapters: node packages/angular/tests/forms.mjs && node packages/vue/tests/forms.mjs && node packages/vue/tests/generation.mjs && node packages/svelte/tests/types.mjs
scripts.verify:dx: pnpm check:environment && pnpm test:cli && pnpm test:adapters && pnpm test:ssr-contracts && pnpm verify:consumer-types && pnpm verify:package-size
scripts.test:security: pnpm --filter @awc-ui/showcase-kit build && node --experimental-strip-types --test scripts/tests/app-security.test.mjs scripts/tests/html-comments.test.mjs scripts/tests/markdown-text.test.mjs scripts/tests/serve-docs-prod.test.mjs scripts/check-docs-release.test.mjs apps/docs/src/lib/htmlToTechnology.test.mjs packages/showcase-kit/src/dock/state.test.mjs packages/showcase-kit/src/design/selectors.test.mjs

pnpm-note: Pins @storybook/test-runner (0.24.4) onto the jest 29 tree. It otherwise pulls jest 30 (jest/jest-circus/jest-runner/jest-environment-node), which brings jest-runtime@30 into the store; @stencil/core's `stencil test` then loads jest-runtime@30 against the jest-29 resolver API and crashes (normalizeCoreModuleSpecifier). test-runner is the sole jest-30 consumer, so scoping its jest deps to 29 removes jest 30 entirely; core keeps its declared jest 29.
pnpm-security-note: Security overrides update vulnerable transitive releases while retaining each supported API line. cookie stays on 0.7 for SvelteKit; uuid 11 retains CommonJS and the v4 API used by sockjs; PostCSS stays on 8; js-yaml 3 and 4 are patched independently. Revisit when upstream minimum versions include these fixes. The Stencil patch awaits Puppeteer 25 browser-path resolution; remove it when upstream does so. Keep Playwright test, component-test, and runtime versions aligned: independently resolving their ranges loads incompatible runners.
